final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.insurstat, step1.avg_remaining, step1.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, step1.avg_remaining / step2.overall_avg AS ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
